City.country: Conventional geographic continents; SAFRICA is the observed encoding for South Africa. Exact source capitalization preserved.

match.Country: Unambiguous continent assignment for the seven observed countries; no transcontinental cases.

airport.Country: Conventional continent partition of the observed airport countries.

weekly_weather.day_of_week: Explicit Monday–Friday versus Saturday–Sunday calendar partition; does not imply local legal working-day rules.

happy_hour.Month: Uses established meteorological seasons with hemisphere explicitly stated; only observed months are annotated.

PROFESSOR.PROF_HIGH_DEGREE: MA/MBA are master-level credentials; DBA/Ph.D. are doctorates. Preserves punctuation in observed degree codes.

STUDENT.STU_CLASS: Conventional US undergraduate lower/upper division classification applied to explicit year codes, not arbitrary numeric buckets.

CLASS.CLASS_TIME: Explicit a.m./p.m. meeting times fall unambiguously into morning, afternoon or evening; original timetable strings remain exact.

Degree_Programs.degree_summary_name: Bachelor versus Master/PhD is the standard undergraduate/postgraduate degree-level distinction.

player.Position: American football positions divide into offense and defense; retain both observed capitalizations of running back.
Standard rugby forwards/backs position classification; Stand Off is a back (fly-half).

fielding.pos: Standard baseball position families; pitcher and catcher kept separately so infield wording is explicit. Designated hitter is a batting-only role retained as its own category.

fielding_postseason.pos: Standard baseball position families; pitcher and catcher kept separately so infield wording is explicit. Designated hitter is a batting-only role retained as its own category.

player.Position: Standard baseball roles; both First Baseman capitalizations retained. Handed pitchers are grouped by shared pitching role.

Customer_Orders.order_status_code: Completed and cancelled orders are terminal outcomes; new, partially filled and pending orders still await completion. Labels describe the observed statuses without inventing a workflow.
